question: 计算积分 $\int_{\pi}^{4\pi} x\sin^3 x\cos^4 x\mathrm{d}x$ .
answer: $$ \begin{array}{r l} I & = \frac {5}{2} \pi \int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} \sin^ {3} x \cos^ {4} x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {5}{2} \pi \int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} (\cos^ {2} x - 1) \cos^ {4} x \mathrm{d} \cos x \\ & = \frac {5}{2} \pi \left[ \frac {1}{7} \cos^ {7} x - \frac {1}{5} \cos^ {5} x \right] _ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} = - \frac {2}{7} \pi . \end{array} $$

steps.text: 分析 积分区间的中点为 $x = \frac{5}{2}\pi$ ，函数 $\sin^3 x\cos^4 x$ 关于直线 $x = \frac{5}{2}\pi$ 对称，将被积函数拆分为 $\left(x - \frac{5}{2}\pi\right)\sin^3 x\cos^4 x + \frac{5}{2}\pi\sin^3 x\cos^4 x$ ，易知前项的积分为零.

$$
I = \int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} \left(x - \frac {5}{2} \pi\right) \sin^ {3} x \cos^ {4} x d x + \frac {5}{2} \pi \int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} \sin^ {3} x \cos^ {4} x d x.
$$

$$
\int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} \left(x - \frac {5}{2} \pi\right) \sin^ {3} x \cos^ {4} x d x = \int_ {- \frac {3}{2} \pi} ^ {\frac {3}{2} \pi} t \cos^ {3} t \sin^ {4} t d t = 0
$$

solution.final_answer: $$ \begin{array}{r l} I & = \frac {5}{2} \pi \int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} \sin^ {3} x \cos^ {4} x \mathrm{d} x = \frac {5}{2} \pi \int_ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} (\cos^ {2} x - 1) \cos^ {4} x \mathrm{d} \cos x \\ & = \frac {5}{2} \pi \left[ \frac {1}{7} \cos^ {7} x - \frac {1}{5} \cos^ {5} x \right] _ {\pi} ^ {4 \pi} = - \frac {2}{7} \pi . \end{array} $$

meta.commentary:
评注（1）用该题方法可得一般结论：若 $f(x)$ 关于 $x = \frac{a + b}{2}$ 对称，则

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} x f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {a + b}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x.
$$

(2) 该题本属于分部积分的类型，可将 $\sin^3 x\cos^4 x$ 凑微分再做分部积分，但计算要困难些.
